title: A page for each person
description: Open anyone from Analytics → People to see their performance against their department and the previous period, and everything behind it.
items: Performance: work, quality, hours, timesheets and attendance
Tasks they are doing or reviewing, open or all
Their timesheet weeks for the last six months
Requests they filed, and client requests they decided at Gate 1
Activity, for the manager and above: what they did in the app and what was changed on their account
